code_edits.reason: state was static and shared by all SeasonSwitch objects; it is now an instance field, so each switch keeps its own state (OFF, COOL or HEAT)

diagnosis: REVIEW-01 fails because the CODE is wrong. `state` is declared static, so every SeasonSwitch object shares one state: after a.cool() the shared state is COOL, so b.off() acts as if b were cooling. It prints "Cooling stopped. RmTemp=70", stops b's timer and sets the shared state to OFF, which also puts switch a into OFF while a's AC keeps running. Each switch must have its own state. Fix: make state an instance field. Room is an inner (non-static) class, so it reads the state of its own SeasonSwitch.
